steps.why: Re-read the model code to understand implementation details.
Trace inputs and outputs to map data flow and dependencies.
Profile input data to capture distributions and anomalies.
Generate initial documentation sections based on gathered insights.

data.rationale: The chosen sequence ensures a thorough understanding of the model’s code, data dependencies, and input characteristics before drafting documentation. This approach aligns with best practices for model risk documentation and highlights potential gaps early.
